create_int_range_eager: create an integer range from 0 to 3 eagerly as a Polars Series
create_int_range_lazy: create an integer range expression for use in a Polars DataFrame pipeline
create_int_range_with_dtype: create an integer range with a custom Polars integer data type like UInt32
create_int_range_with_len: create an index column using int_range with pl.len() in a DataFrame select
create_int_ranges_per_row: create per-row integer ranges from start and end columns in a DataFrame
